links.outcome: Faithful grounding and verifiability of diagnostic responses, tool-grounded agent versus LVLMs on multi-turn benchmark
links.effect: CXReasonAgent, which uses clinically grounded diagnostic tools, produced faithfully grounded responses and more reliable, verifiable diagnostic reasoning than LVLMs; no numeric results in the provided text.
links.quote: and show that CXReasonAgent produces faithfully grounded responses, enabling more reliable and verifiable diagnostic reasoning than LVLMs.

screen.reason: The paper introduces a new agent architecture (CXReasonAgent) combining an LLM with diagnostic tools and benchmarks it on a dataset (CXReasonDial) for evidence-grounded reasoning without evaluating a deployable organizational safeguard or human workflow.
